name: Soothsaying
overview: Scripture clearly condemns soothsaying, familiar spirits, and wizardry as practices that defile God's people and lead them away from Him. The Lord commands His people not to seek after these abominations or consult with those who claim to have supernatural knowledge apart from God, warning that such actions provoke His judgment and separation from the community (Leviticus 19:26, 19:31; 20:6, 20:27). Instead, believers are called to seek the living God rather than turning to the dead or occult practices, affirming a trust in God's provision and guidance alone (Deuteronomy 18:9; Isaiah 8:19).
